mentions.name: miracle-wm WebAssembly plugin system
mentions.description: A WebAssembly plugin system for the Miracle Wayland compositor that lets users program window management, animation, and configuration from plugins built with Rust, avoiding the need for a heavy scripting language; a stable release is planned by mid-year.
mentions.problem: Wayland has lacked a plugin system like this, especially one that avoids a heavy scripting language.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A WebAssembly plugin system for my Wayland compositor: https://github.com/miracle-wm-org/miracle-wm

The idea is that you'll be able to program window management, animation, configuration and more from WebAssembly plugins that are built with Rust.
